name: Quick Arena
tagline: Three fast games. Best total score wins.

missions.title: Reflex
missions.brief: Wait for the orb to turn green, then click. Click early and that round scores zero.

missions.title: Math Sprint
missions.brief: Solve as many as you can. Right answers +100, wrong answers -50.

missions.title: Type Storm
missions.brief: Type the passage exactly as shown. Finishing early earns a bonus.
